policy.notes: A permissive repository tag is not sufficient when the dataset card or source dataset adds non-commercial terms. Code, weights, annotations and source media must be cleared separately.

datasets.relevance: Temporal intervals, anomaly classes, key evidence and explanations; includes stealing and shoplifting examples.
datasets.recommended_use: Violation taxonomy, explanation schema and temporal-localization evaluation. The Hugging Face repository does not provide a clean bank-cashier training corpus.

datasets.relevance: Generic banknote appearance pretraining; no KZT labels and no object-detection boxes.
datasets.recommended_use: Optional auxiliary experiment only. Do not mix its denominations with the final KZT class ontology.

datasets.relevance: Closest camera geometry and hand-object actions: take, put and touch.
datasets.recommended_use: Research reference only unless Standard AI grants commercial permission. The custom license adds a revenue-triggered permission requirement.

datasets.relevance: Normal CCTV, stealing and shoplifting anomaly features.
datasets.recommended_use: Do not train the deliverable on this mirror until both the mirror and original UCF-Crime media rights are cleared.
